title_sq: SHESIM BIZNES BAR , FAST-FOOD/ KREPERI PRANE KRYQEZIMIT TE VASIL SHANTOS !! 8,500 €

title_en: BUSINESS BAR FOR SALE, FAST-FOOD/CREPERI NEAR VASIL SHANTOS CROSSING !! €8,500
